title: wt done's screenshot check always passes: require a screenshot only for tickets with visible UI
description: wt done requires a screenshot under tmp/ but writes its own tmp/<branch>-launch.png first, so the check always passes, while agents on pure refactors still take and copy screenshots. Evidence: ai-workspace reports/tool-review-2026-10-18.md item 11. Require an agent screenshot only when the ticket's subsystem or definition of done names a visible UI change; otherwise the launch run (the entry starts and renders) is enough, and once the test layer exists, a named test instead.
definition-of-done:
1. wt done does not count its own launch screenshot as the ticket's evidence.
2. A refactor ticket passes with the launch run alone; a UI ticket without an agent screenshot is refused with a reason.
testing-plan: 1. Run wt done on a refactor and on a UI ticket with and without a screenshot; paste the outputs.
